ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via Visual Studio Tools for Office
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects persistence via Visual Studio Tools for Office (VSTO) add-ins in Office applications.

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\Word\\\\Addins\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\Excel\\\\Addins\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\Powerpoint\\\\Addins\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\VSTO\\\\Security\\\\Inclusion\\\\.*")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\integrator\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\OfficeClickToRun\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\visio\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Teams\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\AVG\\Antivirus\\RegSvr\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\Antivirus\\\.AsOutExt\\\\.*")))
